reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000758 (the melody read from 000758a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Chretien Urban has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1834, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Edward F. Rimbault's dates (1816–1876) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Rimbault_EF (Rimbault, Edward F. (Edward Francis), 1816-1876); CCEH's page gives only the year 1867. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000758a.nwc).
